operational_baseline.name: AdaptiveKeyframeSelector (WebP)
operational_baseline.rule: Generative candidate must beat adaptive keyframe pasting at matched wire cost (F <= 12 kB) and anatomical fidelity (OKS >= 0.90)

candidates.description: Lightweight conditional GAN conditioned on DWPose keypoint skeleton sequence
SPADE architecture conditioned on multi-class player/court segmentation masks
Latent diffusion with ControlNet pose guidance and IP-Adapter reference cross-attention
Spatial-temporal video diffusion with reference net and pose guider

falsification_rules.wire_exceeded: Candidate total appearance wire exceeds 12,000 bytes
falsification_rules.distortion_uncompetitive: Candidate FG PSNR drops below 35.8 dB without rate savings
falsification_rules.default_action: Retain reference pasting (generation: false) as frozen operational baseline
